# Hermes Optimizer

Hermes Optimizer is a provider-agnostic Hermes Agent skill for auditing and improving routing, fallback, guardrails, checkpoints, and skill-layer noise.

It should autodetect configured providers, subscriptions, and reachable models whenever the environment can be inspected.

## What it does
- detects the active provider stack
- verifies real model routes before suggesting changes
- splits work into heavy / medium / light / vision lanes
- flags weak fallback chains
- disables irrelevant skills safely through config
- prefers reversible high-ROI config changes

## Key files
- README.md
- SKILL.md
- references/provider-autodiscovery.md
- references/platform-skill-trim.md
- notes/current-routing.md

## Install
- `hermes skills install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AzamatSafarov/hermes-optimizer/main/SKILL.md -y`
- `hermes skills tap add AzamatSafarov/hermes-optimizer`
